title: The RELA-FTH1 axis in senescent cancer-associated fibroblasts creates a stromal iron sink that drives ferroptosis resistance and therapy failure across solid malignant tumors.
authors: Ma, Hexin; Zhao, Xinran; Zhang, Zhen; Li, Zhihui; Pan, Xinhua; Zhao, Haoming; Du, Mengxuan; Wan, Qingqing; Zou, Xin; Fu, Jinye; Zhao, Hongyu; Zhang, Xin; Chen, Wan-Tao
journal: Drug resistance updates : reviews and commentaries in antimicrobial and anticancer chemotherapy
one_liner_zh: 该文研究衰老肿瘤相关成纤维细胞通过RELA-FTH1轴形成铁库抑制肿瘤铁死亡并导致耐药，虽涉及转录因子预测和蛋白-DNA分子对接，但核心是肿瘤微环境代谢与耐药机制，非TF-DNA互作建模研究。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Therapy resistance remains the foremost barrier to improving outcomes in solid malignancies. While tumor-cell-intrinsic resistance mechanisms have been extensively studied, the contribution of the tumor microenvironment (TME) to treatment failure is poorly understood. Cellular senescence accumulates across diverse solid tumor types and reshapes the stromal landscape, yet which population dominates this senescent compartment and how senescent cancer-associated fibroblasts (senCAFs) drive resistance remain unresolved. In particular, whether senescent fibroblasts can suppress ferroptosis in neighboring tumor cells-and thereby promote drug resistance-through metabolic reprogramming of iron homeostasis has not been mechanistically dissected. METHODS: We integrated six single-cell RNA sequencing datasets (431,513 cells) to map the senescent landscape of the TME. A 24-gene prognostic senescent fibroblast signature was constructed using LASSO/Cox regression and validated in independent TCGA cohorts. Transcription factor prediction and protein-DNA molecular docking identified upstream regulators. Functional studies employed conditioned medium assays, transwell co-culture systems with ferroptosis induction and chemosensitivity testing, FerroOrange-based intracellular Fe(2)(+) quantification, genetic perturbation (shRNA/siRNA), pharmacological NF-kappaB inhibition, and subcutaneous xenograft models. Spatial transcriptomics validated findings in cancer tissues. Pan-cancer analyses across 31 solid malignant tumor types were performed using GEPIA 2 to assess cross-cancer generalizability. RESULTS: SenCAFs constituted the predominant senescent compartment in the TME, significantly promoting tumor cell proliferation, migration, invasion, and in vivo tumor growth. Multi-omics screening prioritized ferritin heavy chain 1 (FTH1) as the critical effector. Mechanistically, senCAFs upregulated FTH1 to create a stromal iron sink, sequestering microenvironmental Fe(2 +), shielding tumor cells from ferroptosis. Disruption of this stromal iron sink by FTH1 silencing not only restored ferroptosis sensitivity but also resensitized tumor cells to cisplatin-induced apoptosis. This iron sink was transcriptionally driven by RELA; targeting RELA abolished FTH1 expression and the senescence phenotype. Spatial transcriptomics validated the FTH1-senCAF-NF-kappaB axis in situ. Critically, pan-solid tumor analysis also confirmed that upregulation of the RELA-FTH1 axis was associated with poor prognosis and positively correlated with ferroptosis resistance and multiple drug resistance pathways across 31 solid malignancies. CONCLUSIONS: SenCAFs drive therapy resistance by establishing a RELA-FTH1-dependent stromal iron sink. This axis serves as a pan-cancer prognostic and drug resistance biomarker and represents a druggable stromal vulnerability, suggesting that its disruption may resensitize resistant solid malignant tumors to ferroptosis and chemotherapy.
abstract_zh: 背景：治疗耐药仍是改善实体恶性肿瘤疗效的首要障碍。尽管肿瘤细胞内在耐药机制已被广泛研究，但肿瘤微环境（TME）对治疗失败的贡献尚不明确。细胞衰老在多种实体肿瘤类型中累积并重塑基质景观，但哪个细胞群体主导这一衰老区室，以及衰老癌症相关成纤维细胞（senCAFs）如何驱动耐药，仍未得到解答。特别是，衰老成纤维细胞能否通过铁稳态的代谢重编程抑制邻近肿瘤细胞的铁死亡（ferroptosis），从而促进药物耐药，这一机制尚未被深入解析。方法：我们整合了六个单细胞RNA测序数据集（431,513个细胞），绘制了TME的衰老景观。使用LASSO/Cox回归构建了24基因预后性衰老成纤维细胞特征，并在独立TCGA队列中验证。转录因子预测和蛋白-DNA分子对接识别了上游调控因子。功能研究采用条件培养基实验、transwell共培养系统结合铁死亡诱导和化疗敏感性测试、基于FerroOrange的细胞内Fe(2+)定量、遗传扰动（shRNA/siRNA）、药理学NF-kappaB抑制以及皮下异种移植模型。空间转录组学在癌症组织中验证了发现。使用GEPIA 2对31种实体恶性肿瘤类型进行了泛癌分析，以评估跨癌种普适性。结果：senCAFs构成TME中主要的衰老区室，显著促进肿瘤细胞增殖、迁移、侵袭和体内肿瘤生长。多组学筛选将铁蛋白重链1（FTH1）确定为核心效应因子。机制上，senCAFs上调FTH1以形成基质铁汇，隔离微环境中的Fe(2+)，保护肿瘤细胞免受铁死亡。通过FTH1沉默破坏这一基质铁汇，不仅恢复了铁死亡敏感性，还使肿瘤细胞对顺铂诱导的凋亡重新敏感。这一铁汇由RELA转录驱动；靶向RELA消除了FTH1表达和衰老表型。空间转录组学在原位验证了FTH1-senCAF-NF-kappaB轴。关键的是，泛实体瘤分析也证实，RELA-FTH1轴的上调与不良预后相关，并与31种实体恶性肿瘤中的铁死亡耐药和多种药物耐药通路正相关。结论：senCAFs通过建立RELA-FTH1依赖性基质铁汇驱动治疗耐药。该轴作为泛癌预后和药物耐药生物标志物，并代表可靶向的基质脆弱点，提示其破坏可能使耐药实体恶性肿瘤对铁死亡和化疗重新敏感。
